options.content:
### 🛡️ Egress default-deny — audit phase
Everything except **same-namespace**, **CoreDNS** and `egressExceptions` is allowed only by the `global-egress-audit-*` catch-alls and shows up here as *would be denied*. Work the **review queue** down to empty, then delete the catch-alls to enforce. Exceptions live in `k8s/system/cilium/values.yaml`.

panels.title: Would be denied
panels.description: Egress connections in the selected range that only the global-egress-audit-* policies allowed.

panels.title: Enforced denies
panels.description: Egress connections dropped by policy. Stays at 0 until the audit catch-alls are deleted.

panels.title: Workloads to review
panels.description: Distinct source workloads with at least one would-be-denied connection.

targets.expr: count(count by (source_namespace, source) (increase(hubble_policy_verdicts_total{direction="egress", action!="dropped", source_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range]) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Enforcement readiness
panels.description: Share of namespaces sending egress without any would-be-denied connection in the range.

targets.expr: clamp_min(1 - (count(count by (source_namespace) (increase(hubble_policy_verdicts_total{direction="egress", action!="dropped"}[$__range]) > 0)) or vector(0)) / count(count by (source) (increase(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", source!~"reserved:.*|"}[$__range]) > 0)), 0)

panels.title: DNS answers that are NXDOMAIN
panels.description: Mostly search-domain expansion (ndots:5): every external name is first tried as name.<ns>.svc.cluster.local etc. A trailing dot in app config (api.example.com.) skips it.

panels.title: 📋 Review queue — add an exception or decide to block
panels.description: Each row is a distinct would-be-denied flow (source app → destination/port) in the selected range. Once an egressExceptions entry covers it, Last seen stops moving.

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:cilium-agent flow.event_type.type:5 flow.traffic_direction:EGRESS flow.policy_log:in("[\"audit-cluster\"]","[\"audit-world\"]") flow.source.namespace:~"^${namespace}$" | format "<flow.source.pod_name>" as source_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at source_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at source_app | format "<flow.destination.pod_name>" as dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at dst_app | format "<flow.destination.namespace>/<dst_app>" as destination | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"") "<flow.destination_names>" as destination | replace_regexp ("[\\[\\]\"]", "") at destination | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"" and flow.destination_names:"") "<flow.IP.destination> (no DNS)" as destination | format if (flow.destination.identity:in("1","6")) "node <flow.IP.destination>" as destination | format if (flow.destination.identity:"7" or (flow.destination.identity:in("1","6") and flow.l4.TCP.destination_port:"6443")) "kube-apiserver" as destination | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port><flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as port | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port>" as tport | format "<flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as uport | format "icmp" as proto | format if (not uport:"") "udp" as proto | format if (not tport:"") "tcp" as proto | format if (flow.policy_log:~"audit-world") "internet" as scope | format if (flow.policy_log:~"audit-cluster") "cluster" as scope | rename flow.source.namespace as namespace | stats by (scope, namespace, source_app, destination, proto, port) count() connections, min(_time) first_seen, max(_time) last_seen | sort by (last_seen desc)

panels.title: 🕸️ Who talks to whom — all connections by namespace
panels.description: New connections per source → destination namespace (policy verdicts, allowed or not) in the selected range. Diagonal = same-namespace traffic.

panels.title: Packet drops by reason (all, incl. internet scanners)
panels.description: SERVICE_BACKEND_NOT_FOUND is mostly port scans against the public IP. POLICY_DENIED appears once enforcing.

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:cilium-agent flow.event_type.type:5 flow.traffic_direction:EGRESS flow.policy_log:in("[\"audit-cluster\"]","[\"audit-world\"]") flow.source.namespace:~"^${namespace}$" | format "<flow.source.pod_name>" as source_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at source_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at source_app | format "<flow.destination.pod_name>" as dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at dst_app | format "<flow.destination.namespace>/<dst_app>" as destination | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"") "<flow.destination_names>" as destination | replace_regexp ("[\\[\\]\"]", "") at destination | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"" and flow.destination_names:"") "<flow.IP.destination> (no DNS)" as destination | format if (flow.destination.identity:in("1","6")) "node <flow.IP.destination>" as destination | format if (flow.destination.identity:"7" or (flow.destination.identity:in("1","6") and flow.l4.TCP.destination_port:"6443")) "kube-apiserver" as destination | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port><flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as port | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port>" as tport | format "<flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as uport | format "icmp" as proto | format if (not uport:"") "udp" as proto | format if (not tport:"") "tcp" as proto | format if (flow.policy_log:~"audit-world") "internet" as scope | format if (flow.policy_log:~"audit-cluster") "cluster" as scope | rename flow.source.namespace as namespace | fields _time, scope, namespace, flow.source.pod_name, destination, proto, port, flow.IP.destination, node_name | sort by (_time desc) | limit 500

panels.title: 🧭 Who called who — all outbound connections (latest 500)
panels.description: Every new outbound connection from pods, allowed or not. Use the Peer filter at the top to include or exclude internet, LAN (home network / tailnet), cluster (other pods, API server) and node destinations.

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:cilium-agent flow.event_type.type:5 flow.traffic_direction:EGRESS flow.source.namespace:~"^${namespace}$" | format "cluster" as peer | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"" and flow.destination.identity:in("1","6")) "node" as peer | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"" and not flow.destination.identity:in("1","3","4","5","6","7","8")) "internet" as peer | format if (peer:internet and (flow.IP.destination:ipv4_range("10.0.0.0/8") or flow.IP.destination:ipv4_range("172.16.0.0/12") or flow.IP.destination:ipv4_range("192.168.0.0/16") or flow.IP.destination:ipv4_range("100.64.0.0/10"))) "lan" as peer | filter peer:in($peer) | format "<flow.source.pod_name>" as source_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at source_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at source_app | format "<flow.destination.pod_name>" as dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at dst_app | format "<flow.destination.namespace>/<dst_app>" as destination | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"") "<flow.destination_names>" as destination | replace_regexp ("[\\[\\]\"]", "") at destination | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"" and flow.destination_names:"") "<flow.IP.destination> (no DNS)" as destination | format if (flow.destination.identity:in("1","6")) "node <flow.IP.destination>" as destination | format if (flow.destination.identity:"7" or (flow.destination.identity:in("1","6") and flow.l4.TCP.destination_port:"6443")) "kube-apiserver" as destination | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port><flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as port | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port>" as tport | format "<flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as uport | format "icmp" as proto | format if (not uport:"") "udp" as proto | format if (not tport:"") "tcp" as proto | format if (flow.policy_log:~"audit-world") "internet" as scope | format if (flow.policy_log:~"audit-cluster") "cluster" as scope | rename flow.source.namespace as namespace | format if (flow.policy_log:~"allow") "allow" as tag | format if (not flow.policy_log:~"allow" and flow.policy_log:~"audit") "would deny" as tag | format if (flow.verdict:DROPPED) "denied" as tag | fields _time, peer, tag, namespace, flow.source.pod_name, destination, proto, port, flow.IP.destination | sort by (_time desc) | limit 500

kubernetes.container_name:cilium-agent flow.verdict:DROPPED flow.drop_reason_desc:in(POLICY_DENIED, POLICY_DENY) flow.source.namespace:~"^${namespace}$" | format "<flow.source.pod_name>" as source_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at source_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at source_app | format "<flow.destination.pod_name>" as dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at dst_app | format "<flow.destination.namespace>/<dst_app>" as destination | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"") "<flow.destination_names>" as destination | replace_regexp ("[\\[\\]\"]", "") at destination | format if (flow.destination.namespace:"" and flow.destination_names:"") "<flow.IP.destination> (no DNS)" as destination | format if (flow.destination.identity:in("1","6")) "node <flow.IP.destination>" as destination | format if (flow.destination.identity:"7" or (flow.destination.identity:in("1","6") and flow.l4.TCP.destination_port:"6443")) "kube-apiserver" as destination | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port><flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as port | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port>" as tport | format "<flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as uport | format "icmp" as proto | format if (not uport:"") "udp" as proto | format if (not tport:"") "tcp" as proto | format if (flow.policy_log:~"audit-world") "internet" as scope | format if (flow.policy_log:~"audit-cluster") "cluster" as scope | rename flow.source.namespace as namespace | fields _time, namespace, flow.source.pod_name, destination, proto, port, flow.drop_reason_desc, node_name | sort by (_time desc) | limit 500

kubernetes.container_name:cilium-agent flow.event_type.type:5 flow.traffic_direction:EGRESS flow.policy_log:in("[\"audit-cluster\"]","[\"audit-world\"]") flow.source.namespace:~"^${namespace}$" | sort by (_time desc) | limit 200
